en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a gently curving town street lined with two‑ and three‑story houses. Several pedestrians, children, and a horse‑drawn cart are visible on the street. On the left are commercial buildings with German signs on their facades. In the distant right background stands a tall church with a tower and spire overlooking the town. At the top of the card in red print are the captions identifying the town and the street.
